telc A2 Exam: Pattern, Scoring and Study Guidance

Understand telc Deutsch A2: the combined reading and writing block, oral format, official sample test, scoring and a practical preparation checklist.

Start Deutsch 2 / telc Deutsch A2 · Source checked 14 November 2026

See the exam formatOfficial mock and sources

Choose the correct examination

This guide concerns Start Deutsch 2 / telc Deutsch A2 for general language. It is not the A2 Speaking-only product, A2 School, an A2–B1 dual-level examination or a vocational test. The full name matters when selecting material.

Exam format and timing

Published task times; arrival, breaks and appointment length are separate.
PartTask timeWhat to check
ListeningAbout 20 minutesThree parts; follow the task-specific playback instructions.
Reading and writing50 minutes combinedThree reading parts and two writing parts use this shared block.
SpeakingAbout 15 minutesThree parts, usually two candidates; no preparation time.

These are the published standard task times, not a promise of total appointment length. Follow the centre’s instructions for your booked format, breaks and any approved accommodations.

Scoring and partial examinations

The currently linked official A2 mock states a pass requirement of 36 out of 60 points, or 60 percent. Use its scoring instructions and criteria for your practice; this is not Goethe A2’s 45-written/15-speaking rule.

The general telc A2 product page says partial examinations are not available. The linked mock also explains that a failed attempt is repeated as the full written and oral examination.

Switching from Goethe A2?

Goethe A2 assigns separate 30-minute reading, listening and writing sections. General telc A2 has about 20 minutes of listening and a 50-minute reading/writing block. Train the timing and task set that appear in your actual booking.

Read the Goethe A2 guide before transferring a study plan between providers.

Prepare each skill

Listening

Practise short exchanges and everyday messages about arrangements. Note who wants what and whether a time is being proposed, accepted or changed.

Reading

Scan short messages and practical information, then return to the exact evidence for your choice. Do not infer an opening time or condition that the text does not provide.

Writing

Practise supplying information in a form and composing the requested short message. Keep all content points visible in your plan and leave time to check the recipient and tense.

Speaking

Practise introducing yourself, exchanging information and agreeing an arrangement. Respond to your partner’s alternative rather than repeating your first suggestion unchanged.

Build a preparation sequence

The following is Klarweg’s study advice, not an official schedule or a promise that a set number of weeks produces this level. Adjust the sequence after a diagnostic attempt.

  1. Locate gaps. Attempt the official A2 mock and note which errors come from vocabulary, grammar, task interpretation or time management.
  2. Connect skills. Use one everyday situation for a short reading, a reply and a spoken exchange. Then change a date or preference to practise adapting.
  3. Check timing. Complete the shared 50-minute block without an invented break and rehearse speaking without a preparation period.

Mistakes to avoid

  • Using an A2–B1 mock and assuming its scoring applies to general A2.
  • Writing an attractive message that omits a required point.
  • Preparing a long monologue when the partner exchange requires listening and responding.

Check readiness before booking

  • I know which A2 product I have selected.
  • I can manage reading and writing within their shared block.
  • I can cover the message instructions in connected simple sentences.
  • I can propose a plan and respond to a partner’s suggestion.

Use the official answer key for objective items. For writing and speaking, compare the published criteria and seek specific feedback; an unchecked self-score is not a reliable pass prediction.

Common questions

Does this guide cover A2–B1?

No. A dual-level examination has a different task and result framework. Use its own official product page and mock.

Is there speaking preparation time?

The general telc A2 product page lists no preparation time. Confirm the session arrangements in your centre’s instructions.

Fees, dates and your exam centre

Ask the examination centre for the current fee, available date, full examination name, delivery format, cancellation terms and identification rules. This guide does not sell places, guarantee availability or quote a nationwide fee.

Find an examination centre through telc and confirm that it offers your exact test. If a certificate is needed for admission, work or an official process, confirm acceptance with the receiving organisation.
